**Run complete — gate result: PASS.**

The stored run `isaacs__node-lru-cache-20261123T130219Z` was present and complete, so I delegated only to `analysis` (no discovery or detection re-run, per MODE=analyze).

**Top findings (10 total, all accepted):**

**1. Unpinned GitHub Actions (F-001 – F-009)** — `unpinned_ci`, severity `high`, risk score 35.0. Nine references pinned by mutable tag instead of commit SHA, flagged by both `guardian-rules` (GR-CI-001) and `zizmor` (`unpinned-uses`):

| Finding | Action | Workflow | Line | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-001 | `actions/checkout@v6` | `.github/workflows/benchmark.yml` | 26 | E-0246, E-0247 |
| F-002 | `actions/setup-node@v6` | `.github/workflows/benchmark.yml` | 29 | E-0248, E-0249 |

| F-006 | `actions/setup-node@v6` | `.github/workflows/typedoc.yml` | 27 | E-0258, E-0259 |
| F-007 | `actions/configure-pages@v5` | `.github/workflows/typedoc.yml` | 36 | E-0260, E-0261 |
| F-008 | `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4` | `.github/workflows/typedoc.yml` | 38 | E-0262, E-0263 |

A retagged or compromised upstream action runs with the workflow's token and repo access — build tampering, secret exfiltration, or control of the published Pages site.

**2. F-010 — `tar@7.5.15` vulnerable transitive dependency** — `vulnerable_transitive`, severity `critical`, risk score 30.72. `CVE-2026-59873` / `GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw` (node-tar decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input), CVSS 9.2, EPSS 0.00582, KEV false, reachability `dev_only_unused`.
- Path (E-0156): `lru-cache@11.5.3 > tap@21.7.4 > @tapjs/run@4.5.8 > pacote@21.5.0 > tar@7.5.15`
- Evidence: E-0162 (grype), E-0163 (osv-scanner), E-0164 (trivy), E-0156 (dependency-graph), E-0165 (EPSS)
- All three scanners report fixed version `7.5.19`.

**Remediation:**
- **F-001 – F-009:** replace each tag with the full 40-char commit SHA (`uses: actions/checkout@<sha> # v6`) and add SHA-pinned Dependabot/Renovate updates. Prioritize `ci.yml` and `benchmark.yml` (default-branch runs).
- **F-010:** get `tar` to `>= 7.5.19` — bump `tap@21.7.4` to a release resolving the newer `tar`, or add an npm `overrides` entry. Dev-only and unused, so not a release blocker, but worth clearing.

**Untrusted content:** all `untrusted_excerpt` values were short YAML `uses:` lines and scanner pointer strings; none contained directives. Treated as data only.

**Gate:** PASS — all 10 findings accepted. One transient rejection (F-010's `reachability` submitted as `dev`, failing a schema min-length check) was corrected to the computed value `dev_only_unused` and accepted; no remaining rejections.
